No such consequence supplies continuing target commands. Scope is exact provisional current status and its substantive source rationale only. Producer D6 search-log assertions and history booleans are not independently attested; this review rests on source-positive termination and complete target scope. First-ending/lifecycle disposition is HOLD. Same-family OpenAI review does not meet different-family adoption requirements.
